upstream.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

classification.analysis: Superpowers is a widely-adopted (270,000+ star) agentic skills framework and software-development methodology for coding agents, providing composable skills for brainstorming and spec refinement, TDD-driven implementation planning, subagent-driven execution with two-stage code review, and worktree-based branch management. It auto-triggers via hooks and bootstrap files across a dozen different agent harnesses (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Devin, and more), is backed by Prime Radiant, and includes an eval harness for testing skill behavior. Aimed at developers who want a rigorous, opinionated SDLC methodology baked into their AI coding agent rather than ad-hoc prompting.

use_cases.title: Give your coding agent a rigorous spec-to-code SDLC methodology
Enforce TDD and code review discipline in AI-driven development
Run subagent-driven development with automatic two-stage review
